profiles.adopted_edition: 2016 PLOS article plus 2017 publisher Fig9-legend correction
profiles.source_scope: Central main-article state/control/estimation equations and official Fig9 correction; S1 mathematical support is listed but its bytes were not independently frozen in W5.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:state-dependent-observation-estim: Kalman-style state estimator whose sensory observation reliability depends on movement state/visibility, so observation noise is state dependent.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:affine-feedback-feedforward-contr: Optimal controller has an affine control law; feedback acts on estimated state while a nonzero feedforward term appears when sensory reliability depends affinely on state.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-09:alternating-control-estimation-op: Control sequence and estimator gain are alternately updated to convergence because signal- and state-dependent noise breaks the classical separation of controller and estimator.

profiles.central_computational_state: Physical hand/arm state plus its estimated state under signal-dependent motor noise and state-dependent sensory noise.
profiles.transition_update_rule: Linear stochastic plant update together with Kalman-style state-estimate update; control and estimator gains are iteratively co-optimized.
profiles.control_decision_operator: Affine optimal motor command combining state-feedback and feedforward terms.
profiles.inference_planning_operator: Optimal stochastic control/estimation iteration minimizes expected movement cost while exploiting actions that improve future sensory information.

learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.learned_variables: No experience-trained latent task policy is central; time-indexed controller/estimator quantities are solved from the specified model.
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.task_world_variables: arm/hand state, control signal, velocity/direction, cursor-visibility rule, motor and sensory noise
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.fitted_latent_variables: noise/cost/participant parameterization; not a hidden task-set state
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.experimental_outcomes: human/model reach trajectories and direction-dependent kinematic statistics

adverse_source_limits: Original live Fig9 caption remains historically distinct from the publisher correction; W5 never overwrites the original record.
The correction repairs only the Fig9 legend panel relation and is not evidence for a different central model.
S1 Text bytes were not independently frozen; no claim of exhaustive model mathematics is made.

profiles.adopted_edition: 2023 current PLOS article; Funding-only correction recorded separately
profiles.source_scope: Central BG motor-selection/novelty-learning and cerebellar reservoir/CPG mechanisms from the publisher article; earlier proof and Funding correction remain separate editions.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:bg-novelty-hebbian-goal-action-ma: Motor basal ganglia select concrete actions and learn goal-to-action associations with dopamine-modulated three-factor Hebbian plasticity driven by movement novelty.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:cerebellar-reservoir-error-correc: A recurrent reservoir learns endpoint-error-dependent corrections to CPG motor-program parameters, refining actions selected by the basal-ganglia system.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-10:bg-cerebellum-serial-motor-learni: The central full model composes strategic/concrete BG action selection with cerebellar correction of motor execution rather than treating either subsystem alone as the complete learner.

profiles.central_computational_state: Motor goal, selected concrete action/CPG parameters, BG activity/association state, cerebellar reservoir state and reached endpoint/error.
profiles.transition_update_rule: Novelty-modulated three-factor BG synaptic update plus perturbation/error-driven cerebellar reservoir output update across reaches.
profiles.control_decision_operator: BG direct-pathway disinhibition selects a concrete action; cerebellar output modifies CPG parameters to reduce endpoint error.
profiles.inference_planning_operator: Hierarchical upstream planning is inherited conceptually, but this paper's tested model focuses on motor-loop goal-to-action selection and execution correction.

learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.learned_variables: BG goal/action association weights and cerebellar reservoir output corrections/projection weights
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.task_world_variables: motor goals, joint/hand state, CPG parameters, target endpoint, perturbations and sensed reach outcome
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.fitted_latent_variables: simulation learning rates/noise/reservoir and perturbation hyperparameters; not a behavioral hidden context
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.experimental_outcomes: endpoint error, adaptation/generalization, after-effects and performance curves

model_variants.name: combined BG plus cerebellar CPG model
reservoir directly driving joint-angle changes without CPG

adverse_source_limits: The June 2023 correction is Funding-only and cannot be promoted into a scientific model revision.
The prior BG papers are direct ancestors of the BG constituent; this does not make the full BG+cerebellum model identical to those ancestors.
W5 does not silently equate the earlier proof with the current publisher article.

profiles.adopted_edition: 2026 PLOS Version of Record/current publisher article
profiles.source_scope: Publisher main article central FI, OI and joint inference mechanisms and explicit inherited model references; no exhaustive correction registry claim.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:feature-successor-context-inferen: Feature inference maintains context-specific successor-feature maps and a Bayesian belief over latent contexts using prediction mismatch and a sticky-CRP prior.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:outcome-map-context-inference: Outcome inference reuses an existing transfer-learning model with context-specific outcome/reward predictive maps to infer latent context from behavioral outcomes.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-11:joint-feature-outcome-context-int: The tested joint strategy combines feature-based and outcome-based contextual evidence, then uses context-conditioned learned action/value representations for choice.

profiles.central_computational_state: Latent context belief over z together with context-specific successor-feature, outcome/reward and TD/action-value maps.
profiles.transition_update_rule: Bayesian/Kalman-style context-conditioned map updates with sticky-CRP prior/particle inference; context-specific TD/action-value maps update for behavior.
profiles.control_decision_operator: Action selection uses the representation/value map associated with the inferred context after joint or component context inference.
profiles.inference_planning_operator: Bayesian hidden-context inference integrates environmental feature prediction and behavioral outcome evidence; feature and outcome modules are separable inherited components.

learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.learned_variables: successor-feature maps, outcome/reward predictive maps and context-conditioned TD/action-value maps
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.task_world_variables: maze location, cues/features, actions, reward contingencies, transitions and trial/block schedule
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.fitted_latent_variables: latent context z and its posterior/belief plus separately tuned model hyperparameters
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.experimental_outcomes: attempt counts/performance, context inference accuracy and simulated representational/splitter measures

adverse_source_limits: Feature inference and outcome inference are explicitly inherited components; W5 does not claim de-novo invention of either.
Latent context belief is distinct from learned maps, task/world variables and empirical outcome measures.

profiles.adopted_edition: 2018 PLOS Version of Record/current publisher article
profiles.source_scope: Publisher main article independent/joint clustering, CRP inference, planning and meta-agent; S1 unknown-transition implementation is retained as noncanonical because W5 did not byte-freeze it.

operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:independent-reward-mapping-crp: Independent clustering assigns a context separately to reward-function and mapping/transition-function clusters under CRP priors, enabling recombination across contexts.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:component-binding-planning: Separately learned reward and mapping/transition functions are bound through planning to construct a policy for the current context.
operator_source_descriptions.INT-12:joint-task-clustering-comparator: Joint clustering assigns each context to one holistic cluster governing both functions and serves as the explicit non-compositional comparison inherited from prior task-structure models.

profiles.central_computational_state: Bayesian posterior/MAP hypotheses over reward and mapping clusters (independent agent) or joint task clusters, together with learned component functions and planned policy.
profiles.transition_update_rule: Bayesian/CRP cluster-assignment updates from observed reward and mapping/transition data; learned component functions feed value iteration/planning and optional model-evidence meta-arbitration.
profiles.control_decision_operator: Policy generated from bound component functions is selected with the paper's action-selection rule; the extension meta-agent samples independent versus joint policy by model evidence.
profiles.inference_planning_operator: Nonparametric Bayesian task-structure inference separates or couples reward and mapping clusters; planning recomposes independent components into action policy.

learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.learned_variables: reward functions, mapping/transition functions, cluster sufficient statistics and resulting policies
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.task_world_variables: context, grid state, primitive/cardinal actions, rewards/goals and environmental mapping/transition structure
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.fitted_latent_variables: reward-cluster and mapping-cluster assignments or joint task-cluster assignment; CRP/model-evidence latent structure
learned_task_fitted_outcome_distinctions.experimental_outcomes: simulated steps/performance, transfer/generalization, information gain/model evidence and policy-selection behavior

adverse_source_limits: The paper explicitly leaves open whether human learning is better described by independent, joint or a mixture of the two.
The unknown-transition S1 variant is not byte-frozen and cannot be promoted to W5 canonical.
Control/gating/hierarchy vocabulary alone is not ancestry evidence for P11, P12 or other CTL papers.
